signals.name: Taiwan Semiconductor
signals.thesis: TSM at $441.40 (+4.1%) near its 52-week high ($450) amid the AI-semis melt-up (NASDAQ +3.07%, Nikkei +4.99%). The world foundry leader makes every major AI accelerator. Options flow is heavily bullish across ITM/OTM calls. RSI 59.4 leaves room, price +9.8% above EMA50 (under the 20% cap), +30% above EMA200. Given the +4.1% session, entry favors an intraday VWAP pullback over chasing the gap.

signals.name: VanEck Semiconductor ETF
signals.thesis: SMH closes at an all-time high ($647, +4.4%) led by NVIDIA/TSM/AVGO/AMD — diversified exposure to the day's leading theme without single-name risk. RSI 65 below overbought. Extension is real (+22% above 50-DMA) but it is a broad ETF at ATH in the strongest theme; the large put OI ($380-465) is structural hedging, not smart-money short. Pullback entry after the +4.4% session, stop below EMA20 ($593).

signals.name: Banco Santander
signals.thesis: Santander breaks its 52-week high ($13.30) at $13.14 (+2.1%) on a fresh AmericanBulls BUY (Jun 11) and bullish MACD cross. The Spanish bank benefits from the European value re-rating: rising ROTE, capital returns, LatAm + Europe footprint. Forward P/E ~10x is cheap. RSI 63 healthy. Entry on the breakout zone, stop below EMA20. Bank = non-Sharia (interest income).

signals.name: CSX Corporation
signals.thesis: CSX consolidates just below its 52-week high ($48.03) at $47.39 (-0.4% today, healthy pause). Eastern US rail benefits from re-industrialization, intermodal volume and restored pricing power. RSI 60.4 with EMA20>EMA50>EMA200. Very tight ATR (2.0%) allows a close stop at the -3.0% floor with 1:1.9 R/R. Entry near spot since it did not run today. AmericanBulls BUY Jun 2.

signals.name: Rio Tinto
signals.thesis: Rio Tinto ($105.89, +0.5%) extends its uptrend 6% below its 52-week high ($112.58) on the metals rally (gold +2.2%, silver +3.1%). Diversified mining — iron, copper, aluminum, lithium — captures both AI/infra demand (copper = data-center wiring) and the precious-metals bid. Strong balance sheet (low net debt), ~3.8% yield. RSI 53.9, +3.6% above EMA50 = healthy, non-extended. AmericanBulls BUY Jun 11.

signals.name: Amgen Inc
signals.thesis: Amgen ($350.53, -1.3% healthy pause) shows a clean bullish MACD cross (3.35 > 1.26) above its EMA20/50 (~$342). Obesity pipeline (MariTide) plus oncology/inflammation support growth, while the defensive profile (beta 0.42) stabilizes the book in a moderate-confidence regime. RSI 57.5 healthy, contained ATR (2.7%) for a -4.0% stop. 10% below its 52w high ($391). High debt = non-Sharia.

signals.name: Saia Inc
signals.thesis: Saia ($474.19, -1.8% pullback) stays in strong momentum 4% below its 52-week high ($494.71), with an AmericanBulls BUY Jun 11. The LTL carrier benefits from terminal-network expansion and recovering industrial freight volume. Price +7.3% above 50-DMA (under the 20% momentum cap), RSI 54.8 healthy. Today's pullback offers a clean entry toward EMA20 ($468). Wide stop (-7.0%) calibrated on the elevated ATR.

signals.name: TKO Group Holdings
signals.thesis: TKO ($201.19, -0.7%) holds above its EMA20/50 with a bullish MACD and an AmericanBulls BUY Jun 5. Owner of UFC and WWE — a pure-play on sports rights with recurring contractual revenue, pricing power on TV/streaming renewals, and international growth. 11% below its 52w high ($226.94), RSI 52.5 = comfortable room. Entry near spot. Sports entertainment + high debt = non-Sharia.

signals.name: VanEck Gold Miners ETF
signals.thesis: GDX surges +6.5% to $85.27, reclaiming its 200-DMA ($83.91) on the gold ($4,331, +2.2%) and silver ($70, +3.1%) rally. Gold miners offer operating leverage on the metal: at constant gold, margins widen. AmericanBulls flipped BUY Jun 12 and volume is massive (34M). RSI 50.4 = early-stage reversal, no overbought. Given the +6.5% session, entry favors an intraday pullback; stop below the recent floor ($78.95).

signals.name: Instacart (Maplebear)
signals.thesis: Instacart ($42.18, +2.3%) breaks out of a multi-month base where EMA50 ($40.70) and EMA200 ($40.68) flattened then turned up. The US grocery-delivery leader is profitable, generates cash (EV < mcap = net cash) and monetizes a high-margin retail-media ad platform. RSI 54.6 and bullish MACD confirm the base breakout. Forward P/E ~9x is reasonable. Entry on the breakout zone, stop below EMA50.
